report:
Skin, abdomen, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a punch biopsy of skin. Bisected and all embedded in 1 block.

(1) Punch, bisected, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. The epidermis shows basal vacuolar change, apoptotic keratinocytes in the basal and lower spinous layers and lymphocyte satellitosis. Apoptotic cells are also seen in the follicular epithelium. The dermis shows a sparse superficial perivascular infiltrate of lymphocytes. The overall features are those of an interface dermatitis and likely represent acute graft-versus-host disease (Lerner grade II). Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, abdomen, punch biopsy - INTERFACE DERMATITIS, likely ACUTE GRAFT-VERSUS-HOST DISEASE (Lerner grade II)
